data.name: AOBAKWE PHENYO MASWABI CV
data.summary:
I am a passionate, solutions-driven IT graduate holding a Bachelor of Science (Honors) in Network Security and Computer Forensics from Botho University, Botswana. Through both academic and professional engagements, I have built a solid foundation in technical support, cybersecurity awareness, and customer relationship management. While serving as an IT Support Intern at Educational Computer Services (ECS) and later as a Data Indexing Consultant with the Bank of Botswana, I consistently resolved complex user issues—achieving a 90% first-contact resolution rate and a 95% customer satisfaction score. I take pride in my ability to bridge the gap between complex IT systems and end-user understanding, simplifying processes and enhancing digital confidence.

Beyond the workplace, I actively contributed to the Botho University IT Club as a Cybersecurity Advocate, where I led digital literacy workshops, facilitated hands-on training in basic network security, and empowered both students and staff to better understand and navigate digital threats. These volunteer experiences not only deepened my technical skillset but also instilled a strong sense of responsibility toward community-driven tech education.

With every opportunity, I strive to blend technical knowledge with communication, adaptability, and a growth mindset—qualities I believe are essential in today’s fast-evolving digital landscape. I am excited to continue this journey of learning, contributing, and innovating in the IT and cybersecurity space.
